---
applyTo: "i18n/**"
---

# Internationalization (i18n)

## File Structure

- `i18n/messages.json` — English (default locale, source of truth for all keys)
- `i18n/messages-<locale>.json` — Translated locales (16 files: ar, cs, de, es-ES, eu, fr, he, id, it, ja, nl, pl, pt-PT, sv-SE, zh-CN)
- `i18n/i18n.js` — Locale resolver bootstrap (uses `XHRLocaleResolver` from `@nuxeo/nuxeo-ui-elements`)

## Key Conventions

- Keys use dot-separated namespaces: `<component>.<property>` (e.g., `defaultSearch.fullText`, `documentPage.delete`)
- Placeholder keys use `.placeholder` suffix (e.g., `defaultSearch.fullText.placeholder`)
- Action keys use imperative verbs (e.g., `command.add`, `label.create`)
- Keep keys alphabetically sorted within the JSON file

## Adding Keys

1. Always add new keys to `i18n/messages.json` first (English)
2. Add stub entries to all 16 locale files — use the English value as a placeholder
3. Keys must be valid JSON strings; values support simple variable substitution with `{0}`, `{1}`, etc.

## Build-Time Merge

`scripts/merge-messages.js` merges messages from multiple sources into `.tmp/i18n/`:
- Base: `i18n/messages*.json`
- Addon i18n: `addons/<name>/i18n/messages*.json` (for addons listed in `NUXEO_PACKAGES`)
- nuxeo-ui-elements i18n: `node_modules/@nuxeo/nuxeo-ui-elements/i18n/`

Later sources override earlier ones — addon and library keys take precedence over base keys with the same name.

## Usage in Components

- Templates: `[[i18n('key')]]` or `[[i18n('key', arg0, arg1)]]`
- JavaScript: `this.i18n('key')` or `this.i18n('key', arg0)`
- Requires `I18nBehavior` (from `@nuxeo/nuxeo-ui-elements/nuxeo-i18n-behavior.js`)

## Rules

- Never hardcode user-facing strings in templates — always use i18n keys
- Do not modify locale files other than `messages.json` for new features — translations are managed via Crowdin
- JSON files must be valid JSON (no trailing commas, no comments)
- The `messages.json` file is ~1500 lines — avoid unnecessary diffs by maintaining key order
